question: What pickup times are available?
answer: We pick up and deliver {site:service_days}. Morning, midday and evening windows are available depending on your area, and you can book a window up to 60 minutes before it ends.

question: What is the turnaround time?
answer: Most orders come back the next service day. Same-day delivery is available in most areas for an extra {fee:Same-Day Surcharge}. We run {site:service_days}, so a Saturday pickup comes back Monday.

question: What cleaning products do you use?
answer: Free & Clear hypoallergenic detergents, white vinegar and Oxi. We never use bleach, fragrances or softeners.

question: Who actually does my laundry?
answer: We do, every step of the way. Everyone who touches your laundry is a Family Laundry employee. Our trained launderers work in our own facilities, and our drivers use our own delivery vehicles. We never outsource.

question: Do you bleach whites?
answer: No, we never use chlorine bleach. We offer bleach alternatives instead: Vinegar ({price:Vinegar} per bag) and Oxi ({price:Oxi} per bag).

question: Why only Free & Clear detergents?
answer:
A lot of people are sensitive to fragrances and the additives in conventional detergents, and plenty of households simply prefer to avoid them. Free & Clear is the choice that works for everyone, so we make it our standard.

It also means your laundry comes back smelling like nothing at all: clean, not perfumed. If you'd like a boost, we offer vinegar and Oxi as add-ons.

question: How can I reach you?
answer:
Call {site:phone}. If we miss your call, leave a voicemail and we'll call you back as soon as possible. You can also email {site:email} anytime.

Returning customers can reply to our last text.

question: Do you offer Subscription Plans?
answer:
Yes. For {plan:price}/month you get {plan:lbs} lbs of wash & fold (about 4 bags), unlimited pickups and free next-day delivery.

Usage above {plan:lbs} lbs is {plan:overage}/lb. Same-day delivery is {fee:Same-Day Surcharge}, and add-ons are charged separately. Stop anytime. Subscribe in the app or email {site:email}.

question: Can I bring my laundry to you?
answer:
Absolutely! Bring it to {site:dropoff_address}, open {site:dropoff_hours} — our drop-off counter is open every day, even though pickup and delivery runs {site:service_days}. {site:dropoff_cutoff} Drop-off wash & fold is {retail:Wash & Fold}.

A note for customers with fragrance or detergent sensitivities: laundry dropped off at our retail location is processed in a facility that is open to the public, so the machines may hold trace residue from other customers' products. If you are highly sensitive, use our pickup & delivery service, which is processed separately in our dedicated facility.

question: Will you do laundry for my business?
answer: Absolutely! We serve Airbnb hosts, hotels, salons, childcare centers, massage and chiropractic practices, gyms, grocery stores and other local businesses. [Get a quote](/services-4).

question: How do I download the Family Laundry app?
answer: Get the Family Laundry app for iOS or Android, or use it on the web at [app.familylaundry.com](https://app.familylaundry.com). Schedule pickups, track orders and manage your account.
